Appearance:
MR L G SUDANI(13710) for the Applicant(s) No. 1 MR. RAJAN J PATEL(6775) for the Applicant(s) No. 1 MR TIRTHRAJ PANDYA APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1 ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE M. R. MENGDEY  Date : 14/12/2023

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ORAL ORDER 1.

By way of the present application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, the applicant-accused has prayed for anticipatory bail in connection with the FIR being FIR No.11195035231040 of 2023 registered with Palanpur Taluka Police Station, Dist.Banaskantha for the offences punishable under Sections 307, 342, 328, 323, 498A, 506(2) and 114 of the Indian Penal Code.

2. Heard learned advocate Mr.Rajan J. Patel for the applicant.
2.1
He submitted that the first informant is a patient NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/22218/2023 ORDER DATED: 14/12/2023 undefined of anxiety and she was taken to doctor for her treatment for the same.
The doctor had prescribed several medicines / drugs to her and the pills which were allegedly to have been administered by the present applicant to the first informant.

He submitted that on the day of Diwali, the first informant had gone missing and had posted a message on the Jitendrabhai Bachubhai Patel vs State Of Gujarat on 14 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25133094/
1 whats- up group of her family that she was going to commit suicide. Having seen the said message,
the applicant along with other relatives had gone in search of the first informant.

entities.text: Jitendrabhai Bachubhai Patel vs State Of Gujarat
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The first informant had gone to their house at Palanpur.

The applicant and other relatives had also gone to the said house and found that first informant was hiding herself below the bed and upon being found out she was behaving mysteriously and in order to calm her down the applicant and relatives were trying to administer pills to her.
The marriage life of the present applicant and first informant is more than 20 years.

2.2 He submitted that applicant has been falsely implicated in the offence and, therefore, prayed to NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/22218/2023 ORDER DATED: 14/12/2023 undefined allow the present application and grant anticipatory bail to the applicant on any suitable condition.

3.1 Per contra, learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing on behalf of the respondent - State has opposed grant of anticipatory bail contending that present applicant happens to be the husband of the first informant and first informant was meted out physical and mental torture at the end of the present applicant.
He, therefore, prayed to dismiss the present application.

3.2 Learned advocate Mr.Bhavik Patel for the first informant has also opposed the present application contending that there is an active participation on the part of the present applicant in commission of offence.
He, therefore, prayed to dismiss the present application.

4. Heard learned advocates for the respective parties and perused the record.
5.1
The present FIR has been lodged by the first NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/22218/2023 ORDER DATED: 14/12/2023 undefined informant who happens to be wife of the present applicant.
The FIR indicates that matrimonial life between the present applicant i.e. husband and the first informant was not smooth and there were several disputes between the two.
It is also alleged that the first informant was subjected to physical and mental torture by the present applicant and other in-klaws of the first informant.
5.2 On the day of Diwali, being faded up of mental torture, the first informant had left her matrimonial house at Village:Vedancha and had gone to her family house at Palanpur.
Thereafter she had posted a message on the whats-up group of her family that she was going to commit suicide.

The present applicant and other relatives went in search of first informant and she was found present at the house of applicant at Palanpur where as per the allegations levelled in the FIR, the first informant was administered pills forcibly by the present applicant.

The present applicant being the husband of the first informant was directly responsible for physical and mental torture with which the first NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/22218/2023 ORDER DATED: 14/12/2023 undefined informant was subjected to which had driver her to leave her matrimonial house.
6.
Considering the above aspects and for the above reasons only, this application is dismissed.
Rule is discharged.
No order as to costs.
